about_short_description.short_description: Balance is a digital payments platform designed to make the B2B online purchasing experience delightful for buyers and vendors alike.

product.name: Digital Trade Credit
product.description: A B2B trade-credit platform that lets businesses offer buyers payment terms while automating credit decisions, financing, invoicing, and reconciliation.

product.name: B2B Payments
product.description: A payment infrastructure stack for accepting ACH, wires, credit cards, and global payments, while supporting cost optimization, surcharging, incentives, and cash application.

product.name: Order-to-Cash
product.description: An order-to-cash platform for automating business onboarding, credit, invoicing, collections, cash application, and accounts-receivable operations.

product.name: Marketplace OS
product.description: A B2B marketplace payments platform for buyer checkout, vendor payouts, embedded trade credit, multi-vendor transactions, and transaction compliance.

product.name: Pay-By-Invoice
product.description: An embedded B2B payment-by-invoice service that enables buyers to purchase on invoice terms while sellers receive managed payment and receivables support.

product.name: B2B BNPL
product.description: An embedded business buy-now-pay-later service that provides financing at checkout, allowing SMB and enterprise buyers to pay over terms of up to 90 days.
